Name: Olivia Korean Wedding Dress
Author: Elaho
TagLine: Changes Olivia's wedding sprite to include traditional Korean regalia, with slight seasonal variations.
Description:
**UPDATE: V.1.1.3 [or higher] is now compatible with Poltergeister's Seasonal Outfit Mods (SVE, SVE Cuter, and Seasonal Cute)**

This mod changes Olivia’s wedding outfit to a traditional Korean Hanbok (Joseon-Style) and includes:

-       The first Hanbok layer, the __Sokchima__  (a corset-like layer with a skirt attached)
-       The second Hanbok layer, the __Chima__  (the Hanbok skirt, usually red)
-       The third Hanbok layer, the __Jeogori__  (the Hanbok jacket)
-       The fourth Hanbok layer, the__Wonsam__ or __Hwalot__  (a ceremonial jacket worn by queens and upper-class women during the Joseon dynasty. Very colourful, this elaborate jacket has red silk on the outside and blue on the inside and is embroidered with flowers to represent wealth, longevity, and nobility.)
-       The fifth Hanbok layer, the__Daedae__ (a belt-like cloth wrapped around the chest to hold the __Wonsam__ in place).
-       __Beoseon__  (socks) and__Hwahye__ (traditional footwear, also known as “flower shoes”)
-       __Jokduri__  (an extravagant cap-like headpiece with detailed embroidery)
-      __Binyeo__ with __Daenggi__  (A long hairpin with two pieces of intricately embroidered cloth attached to the ends)
-       __Yeonji gonji__  (red dots painted or stickered on the cheeks, believed to protect the bride from evil spirits)

Known for their generosity and comforting presence,  the Korean people are welcoming and kind-hearted souls, who offer themselves fully to those they care about. Olivia, a successful and mature woman, is also incredibly generous and kind to everyone around her - not only to those in her family but to everyone in Pelican Town and those beyond the Republic's borders. She shares a love of both elegant tradition and modern innovation, which I think perfectly culminates in her personality and demeanour.

Considering all of this, I thought giving Olivia a Korean background would be the perfect fit for her character. And I think Olivia, being the mature, elegant, open-minded woman she is, would want to share her love of ornate beauty and tradition with you on your special day together.

“__**두분의결혼식날, 축하와따뜻한성원을함께보냅니다.**__”
------------------------------------
*PLEASE NOTE:

**UPDATE: V.1.1.3 [or higher] is now compatible with Poltergeister's Seasonal Outfit Mods (SVE, SVE Cuter, and Seasonal Cute).**

This mod will NOT work with other wedding outfit mods that include Olivia. If you want this mod to be compatible with other sprite editing mods, you'll need to either delete Olivia’s wedding version in those mods or only have this one installed. Having two different mods that change Olivia’s wedding appearance will not work together and may cause the game to crash.*

Compatibility with other outfit mods will be added in a future update.

Please only upload this Mod from Nexus, Curseforge, or ModDrop :) Thank you!
